label: Original preseason forecast
generated_at_basis: file modification time of data/gold/forecast_2026.csv on the build machine; predates every 2026 game (season opened 2026-08-29)
inputs: prior-season SP+ rating, mean net EPA/play, win rate per team (silver.silver_ratings_sp + gold.mart_team_efficiency); 2026 schedule from CFBD /games
scope: FBS-vs-FBS regular-season games only (740 games, 136 teams); games against FCS opponents carry no prediction and are excluded from projected win totals and from scoring
scoring_rule: a game counts toward this version's accuracy only if generated_at precedes kickoff; for v1-preseason that is every 2026 game

forecast_2026.csv.grain: one row per game: game_id, week, start_date, neutral_site, home_team, away_team, home_win_prob, favored_team, favored_win_prob

forecast_2026_teams.csv.grain: one row per team: games, projected_wins, projected_losses, avg_win_prob, projected_rank

coef__priors__r.csv.grain: the exact fitted coefficients the forecast was scored with

terms_note: Derived model output authored by this project — publishable under CFBD's terms (independently created predictions/projections are expressly permitted; no raw API data is included).
